features.title: App skeleton: routing + navigation
features.description: Set up Vue 3 + Vite + Vue Router with the 5 sitemap routes (Home, Services, Cases, About, Contact), a minimal shared layout (header nav + footer), and dark theme base applied. No business logic yet.
acceptance_criteria: App opens in the browser and renders the Home route without a blank screen
Header nav links to all 5 routes and each route renders without error
Footer is present on all routes
features.verification_command: npm run test:unit && npm run build
features.verification_evidence: 2026-08-12 — npm run test:unit: 13/13 passing (router define as 5 rotas do sitemap + rota 404; todas as views resolvem como componentes Vue; App renderiza as 5 rotas sem tela em branco; AppHeader expõe links das 5 rotas + estado ativo; AppFooter presente em todas as rotas; menu mobile abre/fecha). npm run build: OK (vite build). Smoke test dev server: HTTP 200 e <title> OK. Stack validada: Vue 3.5 + Vite 8 + Vue Router 4.6 + Vitest 4.

features.title: Design tokens and global styles
features.description: Implement the color palette, typography, and dark-mode base styles from docs/DESIGN.md as global CSS variables/tokens usable across all pages.
acceptance_criteria: CSS variables exist for all colors listed in docs/DESIGN.md
Heading and body fonts from docs/DESIGN.md are loaded and applied globally
features.verification_command: npm run test:unit && npm run build
features.verification_evidence: 2026-08-12 — npm run test:unit: 24/24 passing (11 novos: 6 tokens de cor do DESIGN.md existem como CSS vars, cor global no body, fontes self-hosted carregadas, --font-display no h1-h6 e --font-body no body, pipeline de imports). npm run build: OK — 2 arquivos de fonte latin (Inter 48 kB + Plus Jakarta Sans 27 kB), sem fontes externas. Smoke test dev: HTTP 200 em /, fonts.css e tokens.css.

features.title: Cross-device responsiveness pass
features.description: Full QA pass across mobile, tablet, and desktop ultrawide for all 5 pages, matching the project's success metric (site fully navigable on desktop and mobile).
acceptance_criteria: No broken layout or dead link on any of the 5 routes at mobile, tablet, and desktop ultrawide widths

features.verification_command: npm run test:unit && npm run build
features.verification_evidence: 2026-08-12 — npm run test:unit: 81/81 passing (3 novos de F014: nenhum link morto — cada href interno resolve via router.resolve em 4 larguras (375/768/1280/2560) por 6 rotas; todas as rotas renderizam <main> com conteúdo em todas as larguras; header/footer e nav presentes em todas as rotas/larguras). npm run build: OK. Interactive (filter/carousel/form/nav) coberto por testes de F005-F009. Observação: a inspeção visual pixel-perfect por viewport recomenda uma conferência manual em browser real (jsdom não renderiza layout CSS), mas a navegação e ausência de dead links está coberta por automação.
